name: Mutanus the Devourer
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, Mutanus the Devourer haunts Naralex's sleeping mind as a pale, monstrous murloc. The creature emerged from the Emerald Nightmare, and must fall before Naralex can awaken.

sections.title: A Dreamer's Worst Fear
sections.body: Naralex, a night elf druid, sought to restore the Barrens by joining its underground springs to the Emerald Dream. Instead, the Emerald Nightmare entered his thoughts. Trapped in an agonizing vision, Naralex's fears took shape through the corruption as an immense, albino murloc.

sections.title: The Waking Nightmare
sections.body: When a Disciple of Naralex begins the ritual to revive their master, Mutanus crosses from dream into waking life. The dark force in Naralex's mind sent him to keep the druid asleep. Until Mutanus falls, Naralex remains trapped in his own corrupted imagination.

aliases: what kind of creature is mutanus
faq.answer: Mutanus the Devourer is a huge, pale murloc-like creature born from the Emerald Nightmare. The aberration came into being in the corrupted mind of the sleeping druid Naralex.

faq.q: Why does Mutanus look like a giant murloc?
faq.answer: Naralex's nightmare took the form of a colossal albino murloc. Why the corruption chose that shape is unknown.

faq.q: Why does Mutanus appear at the end of the ritual?
faq.answer: The dark presence corrupting the Emerald Dream sent Mutanus to keep Naralex asleep. When the disciples begin the awakening ritual, Mutanus crosses into the physical cavern to devour those trying to save the druid.
Mutanus comes from the Emerald Nightmare, the corrupted realm that has ensnared Naralex.
Yes. When Mutanus falls, the nightmare's immediate hold on Naralex's mind breaks. His disciples can then awaken him and end the cavern's dark trance.

faq.q: Why is Mutanus immune to shadow magic?
faq.answer: Mutanus is woven from dark nightmare energies and resists necrotic and shadow spells that would harm ordinary beasts.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the danger of entering the Emerald Dream without safeguards. Naralex's mind was overtaken by corruption.
For the kaldorei, Mutanus embodies the tragedy of Naralex's noble effort to heal the Barrens becoming a monstrous nightmare.
The Horde cannot let Mutanus and the Nightmare corrupt the heart of the Barrens, where vital oasis waters sustain Durotar and Mulgore.
